title: Warm Creamy Brazilian Coconut Pudding
description: A sweet and creamy Brazilian dessert featuring coconut and tarragon, cooked in a copper pot and suitable for ovo-vegetarians.
instructions: In a copper pot, combine the coconut milk, sugar, and salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the warm coconut milk mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the copper pot and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the toasted unsweetened shredded coconut and fresh tarragon leaves.
Strain the pudding into individual serving cups, if desired, and discard the tarragon leaves.
If using binchotan charcoal infused water, stir it in at this point.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate until chilled.
Serve the pudding warm, reheated gently in the copper pot if necessary.
